Why DØi Labs
WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT
Professional aerial services built on commercial-grade systems, certified operators, and a structured deliverable process — not a consumer drone and a Google Drive folder.
Commercial-Grade Equipment
DJI Matrice 4T enterprise systems with 4K RGB, 56× optical zoom, FLIR 640×512 radiometric thermal, and RTK precision — the same platforms used by utility companies, first responders, and defense contractors.
FAA Certified & Insured
Every DØi operator holds an FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate. We handle airspace authorization, NOTAM filing, LAANC approval, and full commercial liability insurance on every operation.
24–48 Hour Turnaround
Standard deliverables are processed and delivered within 24–48 hours of flight completion. Complex mapping and AI analysis projects are scoped with a confirmed delivery window at booking.
Data You Can Actually Use
Every deliverable is organized, labeled, and formatted for your application — engineering reports, insurance packages, real estate media, or board-ready presentations. Not a USB drive full of raw files.
One Vendor, Six Capabilities
Aerial photography, thermal inspection, survey-grade mapping, surveillance, AI data analysis, and custom fabrication — under one contract, one point of contact, and one consistent standard of quality.
California-Based Operations
DØi operates throughout California — Bay Area, Los Angeles, San Diego, the Central Valley, and beyond. We know California airspace, coastal operating conditions, and local regulatory requirements.

How It Works
FROM QUOTE TO DELIVERY
Every DØi mission follows a structured seven-phase protocol — from initial client consultation through secure delivery and long-term archival.
01
MISSION INTAKE
Client consultation and site assessment. We gather mission objectives, property details, airspace considerations, and deliverable requirements to build the correct deployment plan.
02
OPERATIONAL PLANNING
Pre-flight planning, FAA airspace verification, LAANC authorization, risk analysis, weather evaluation, and Matrice 4T equipment preparation.
03
FIELD DEPLOYMENT
Operators deploy on-site with the Matrice 4T configured for the mission — RGB, thermal, mapping, or surveillance mode — under controlled protocols.
04
DATA ACQUISITION
Flight operations capture aerial intelligence: visual imagery, thermal signatures, orthomosaic mapping, or anomaly detection — per mission scope.
05
PROCESSING & ANALYSIS
Post-mission processing: organization, enhancement, AI analysis, and quality control. Outputs include thermal reports, 3D maps, inspection findings, or intelligence summaries.
06
CLIENT DELIVERY
Final deliverables securely delivered in structured packages — optimized for operational use, stakeholder review, insurance support, or long-term asset tracking.
07
ARCHIVE & SUPPORT
Mission data archived for future comparison, repeat inspections, and recurring monitoring programs. Ongoing mission scheduling available for repeat clients.
Operational Data Systems

Trust & Compliance
BUILT FOR PROFESSIONALS
FAA Part 107 Certified
All DØi pilots hold FAA Remote Pilot Certificates — legally authorized for commercial drone operations throughout the United States.
Commercial Liability Insurance
Full commercial drone insurance on every operation. Certificates of insurance available for clients who require them prior to flight.
Airspace Authorization Managed
We handle LAANC authorization, NOTAM filing, and controlled airspace coordination so your project runs legally from day one.
Structured Pre-Flight Protocol
Every mission includes weather evaluation, equipment checks, site assessment, and safety briefing before a single rotor turns.
Secure Deliverable Handling
All mission data is organized, labeled, and transmitted through secure channels. No raw file dumps — structured deliverables only.
California Statewide Coverage
Operating throughout California — LAX Class B, SFO, SAN, Central Valley, coastal corridors. Multi-site projects welcome.
